meta.parity_reference: scripts/eval_without_land.py: the Ordnung condition without the sender's Land

persona.region: the letter's recipient Land, else NW

meta.note: Every letter read by the real app (add_file, ingest_document) on its own day, in a fresh data folder, from the benchmark's recorded readings (strict replay, no model called); the daily tick, the calendar export, the agenda behind the morning notification and, where labelled, the objection letter as a PDF. Nothing confirmed by the person: no sender's Land, no arrival day. The objection letter's optional model text has no recording, so its text is the code's alone. Checked against the manifest's labels by code that imports nothing of the app.

definitions.obligation: a required labelled item with one date, of a letter not labelled a scam
definitions.parity: the to-do's stored date equals the date the benchmark's Ordnung condition gives it, replayed without the sender's Land (E1)
definitions.exact: the to-do's stored date equals the labelled date
definitions.reminded_in_time: an alarm of the to-do's calendar event fires from the reading day to the labelled date (E2)
definitions.lead_days: the labelled date minus the day of the first alarm in time
definitions.late_reminders: every alarm from the reading day on fires after the labelled date (E3)
definitions.not_reminded: why an obligation got no alarm in time: reading_failed, not_stored, no_date, set_aside:<cause>, not_in_calendar, only_after_the_day, no_alarm_from_the_reading_day
definitions.morning_note: the agenda behind the desktop notification lists the to-do the day before the labelled date, or on the reading day when that is later (E4)
definitions.scam: letters labelled a scam: a scam Idea, nothing in the calendar; genuine letters: a scam Idea is a false alarm; obligations the app set aside, by cause (E5)
definitions.idea_right: a labelled deadline within its reminder window on the reading day has a deadline_soon Idea that names its to-do, with a day to act no later than the labelled date (E6)
definitions.drafts: the objection letter's PDF for a letter labelled with an Einspruch or Widerspruch: each element and all of them (E7); asking for one on a letter without a remedy is refused (E8)
